title: Constant Ramp
text: Generate ramp signal with length based on input dimensions, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Data type mode; {Ramp length equals number of} sets the dimension used to determine ramp length, {Dimension}, {Slope}, {Offset} sets the y -intercept of the ramp, {Output data type}, {Signedness}, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Data type override} and {Fraction length}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Ramp length equals number of
params.values: Dimension used to determine ramp length Rows (default) | Columns | Elements in specified dimension

params.name: Dimension
params.values: Dimension that determines length of output ramp 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Signedness of fixed-point data Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 128

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Data type override mode Inherit (default) | Off

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | integer scalar
